title: result.json envelope
description: Common envelope wrapping every stage's result.json (stage, produced_at, status, artifacts, stage_specific).

artifacts.description: Output paths produced by this stage, each promoted into the stage's canonical dir. result.json is promoted automatically and MUST NOT be self-listed here — self-listing collides with the canonical result.json during promote (FileExistsError).

requirement_verdict.description: One verdict on one requirements.json row, as carried by a stage envelope's stage_specific.requirements[]. Defined here because the four stages that judge ledger rows record them identically, and the reap-time validator already registers this resource. `measured` is what closes the row: the ledger names a dimension, the stage names the number it actually read, and a reader can see whether the two are the same quantity.

actual.description: What was measured or observed, in whatever unit the row speaks.

measured.description: The measurement behind this verdict, in the stage's own words: which report, which row, which scope. A dimension name is an index; this is what it indexed.
